subject: planner/infoschema: add predicate pushdown for system tables (#50779)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent b69e5e31: adds `InfoSchemaTablesExtractor` to extract `table_schema`/`table_name` predicates (EQ/IN/OR, CNF-intersection) for INFORMATION_SCHEMA `TABLES/STATISTICS/KEY_COLUMN_USAGE/REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS`, wires it via `LogicalMemTable.PredicatePushDown` and executor-side filtering/SkipRequest short-circuit in `pkg/executor/infoschema_reader.go`. Also avoids unconditional `TableRowStatsCache.Update` by updating only when stats-backed columns are requested, and enables column pruning for `information_schema.TABLES`. No plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantics/privilege/transaction issues found in the new pushdown or projection paths; later history up to `upstream-master` shows no follow-up fix specifically targeting these changes.
